messages.subject: MRDS graphs in R
parts:
Hi,

I’m carrying out analyses of mark recapture distance sampling with R. I’d like to redo the graphs using for example ggplot2, to superimpose several detection probability curves on the same graph. Is there a way to export the data from mrds models to make such a graph  ?

Thanks in advance for your answers.

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] MRDS graphs in R
parts:
Hi Thibault, listfolk,

There isn't an "easy" way to extract this data from the plotting code at
the moment. So the easiest thing to do is to delve into the plot.* code
and try to pull out what you want. Find the corresponding plot file
(e.g. plot.io.R) then it's a case of working out what plot_cond and
plot_uncond will give you, then hack them to return the requisite
data.frames.

A while ago I wrote up how the different parts of the code work and how
they relate to the mathematical quantities in the literature, which may
be useful. You can find that information here:

http://distancedevelopment.github.io/mrds-Plotting.html

If you get somewhere with this then I'd be interested in including it in
mrds. If you have particular issues, feel free to contact me off list.

I hope this is helpful.


best,
--dave
